title: Dock panel does not display system resource values
summary: Command Palette Dock performance indicators show missing, stale or incorrect values on affected systems.

judgment.rationale: Multiple reports and an existing bug report support maintainer reproduction, but the individual causes are not established.
evidence: On 0.98 the reporter supplied a bug report and showed blank resource values; clicking widgets helped one user but not all.
The reporter saw different values on 0.99; another user reported missing GPU, zeros and stale memory on 0.99.1, and another reported the issue on 0.100.2.
Current PerformanceCounterSourceBase logs initialization failures and returns null; CPUStats and MemoryStats obtain data differently. No failed path has been confirmed here.
Several open Performance Monitor card redesign PRs exist, including #51221; their existence does not establish a fix for this report.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce affected dock metrics on a current build and trace collection versus presentation before choosing a correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: Investigate a targeted metric collection or presentation correction once the first failing stage is identified; the related open redesigns are not established as covering this issue.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate missing and stale Dock performance readings
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: some counter initialization, sampling, or presentation update fails on affected systems; the reported symptoms could have different causes.
plan: Reproduce with dock performance widgets on a current build and identify metrics showing missing, stale or implausible values.
Trace initialization, periodic sampling and dock notification separately, using the supplied historical report as context.
Coordinate with active performance card work and implement only a confirmed source or presentation correction.
Add focused regression tests for the observed failure and recovery, preserving valid zero readings.
verification: Compare changing CPU, memory, network and GPU values with independent Windows measurements.
Exercise initial launch, widget interaction, dock restart and missing counter conditions without representing unavailable data as a valid zero.

confidence.rationale: Independent reports and relevant source paths exist, but no current-build reproduction or failing stage is known.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette Dock performance indicators show missing, stale or incorrect values on affected systems.
known_information: On 0.98 the reporter supplied a bug report and showed blank resource values; clicking widgets helped one user but not all.
The reporter saw different values on 0.99; another user reported missing GPU, zeros and stale memory on 0.99.1, and another reported the issue on 0.100.2.
inferences: A counter, sampling, or dock refresh failure could explain some symptoms, but the thread may contain multiple causes.
initial_investigation: Inspected src/modules/cmdpal/ext/Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.PerformanceMonitor/DevHome/Helpers/PerformanceCounterSourceBase.cs, CPUStats.cs and MemoryStats.cs; initialization errors can return null and sources differ.
Reviewed complete issue discussion, labels, linked issues and no current assignee; a report ZIP was supplied but not independently analyzed.
Searched current upstream PR titles for Performance Monitor; #51221 and card redesigns are active, not proven covering fixes.
issue_context.analysis: Existing reports supply sufficient setup and comparisons to investigate without asking for another generic report. Separate missing counters from stale or inaccurate readings and coordinate with active related work.

information_gaps.information: Which metric source or presentation stage fails on a current build, and whether values recover after interacting with widgets.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes counter availability, sampling and dock refresh rather than assuming one root cause.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Maintainer compares dock and detail cards with Task Manager, inspects source initialization and refresh on an affected environment.

reproduce.title: Trace Dock performance metrics
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare the reported 0.98–0.100.2 behavior where practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows machine with Dock and the Performance Monitor extension enabled.
setup: Add CPU, memory, network and GPU indicators to the Dock; make a note of supported hardware and source availability.
steps: 1. Start PowerToys and display Dock performance indicators without opening their cards.
2. Observe initial and changing values against Task Manager while varying workload.
3. Open and close each indicator card and check whether values recover, update, or differ between the card and Dock.
4. In a maintainer diagnostic session, determine whether collection initialization, samples, or Dock notifications are failing.
reproduce.expected_result: Available metrics update over time consistently with system activity; unavailable metrics are distinguishable from legitimate zero values.
